metadata.title: CXMT Earnings Ramp Up Memory Chip War With Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The Memory-Chip Battle Is on as China’s CXMT Posts Explosive Earnings Report
ChangXin Memory Technologies has ridden the artificial-intelligence boom to become China’s most valuable company—and soaring revenue may help power shares even higher next week.
